purpose: Make VRAM calculator assumptions explicit and versioned. This is a planning estimate, not a benchmark.

llmEstimatePolicy.description: Estimate dense LLM weights memory from parameter count and quantization bits, then add planning overhead for quantization/runtime/context before applying a safety margin.
llmEstimatePolicy.formula: estimatedCoreGb = ((modelSizeB * quantizationBits) / 8) * overheadMultiplier + contextOverheadGb + runtimeOverheadGb; estimatedVramGb = estimatedCoreGb * (1 + safetyMarginPercent / 100)
llmEstimatePolicy.warning: Dense LLM planning only. This does not model every architecture, KV cache implementation, batch size, offloading setup, runtime-specific optimization, image diffusion workflow, or Mixture-of-Experts memory behavior.
